text_block_list.text: One night, some time after hearing about Acting Principal Kashimoto's past from Chairwoman Akikawa.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah...! 
She just keeps sticking right on me...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa! Right back at you...!

Little Cocon and Bitter Glace ran side-by-side,
practically clashing against each other.
—A few days prior.

Having heard about Acting Director Kashimoto's past
from Chairwoman Akikawa, everyone on Team First
looked completely at a loss.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
A former student of hers injured in a race, huh...
Knowing her personality, that must have hit her hard...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"That's why he was being doubly strict
about nutritional status and injury risks right now."

Team First fell deathly silent.
Everyone was utterly bewildered.
Then, after some time had passed—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
I'm really grateful to Trainer Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
My abilities have grown, and my physique is solid now.
Enough that the me from three years ago feels like a child.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I want you to keep teaching us, even from now on.
Right, everyone?

Though puzzled by Little Cocon's question,
her teammates firmly nodded back.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: 3 minutes, 6.2 seconds... calculated and produced by Trainer Kashimoto...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: These three years spent relentlessly chasing target times have definitely become part of my strength.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Not just in the Aoharu Cup,
we've been getting solid results
in the Twinkle Series as well."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Trainer Kashimoto's guidance, I was able to make it this far.
I want you to keep teaching me forever and ever.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"That's what I think.
But... that's why...!"

—And Little Cocon lifted her face
with a look of firm resolve.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's why I think... we need to exceed her standards right now.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
3:06.2 is definitely an accurate figure.
It's the top-tier time that Trainer Kashimoto
projected I could reach.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: "Put another way, it means they think I can't go any higher than this."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
I get it, in other words...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: I'll surpass that person's imagination.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, I'm sure
we can shatter those rigid beliefs!
The eyes of the team members, once clouded in gloom, had flared up with fire before anyone knew it.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds great.
Let's smash through them!

Afterward, we discussed our upcoming training,
and quietly parted ways for the day.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: "'I'll exceed that person's imagination.' ...I had no idea you were such a passionate type."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...After hearing a story like that, you can't help wanting to do something about it.

Bitter Glasse stared intently
at Little Cocon's profile as she huffily turned away.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Little Cocon.
Now that we're going to work 'as one team,'
there's something I'm curious about.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: You could have disbanded the team today and made that person your exclusive Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: You'd gain even more than you do now. Seeking strength as you are, I thought that's what you'd choose, but—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Correcting "me" to "we",
swearing to each other to break through our limits...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...What are you trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I'm just saying it's surprising. You've been all on your own ever since you enrolled, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I thought you were like me—the type who found companions, let alone friends, to be a hassle.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Not really.
My perspective has just changed, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: A way of looking at it?

Bitter Glasse urges her on without hesitation.
Little Cocon squirms, looking uncomfortable.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...When I was little,
I was in a local Umamusume team."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
One day, one of my teammates brought over
a sports equipment catalog and said...

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text: "Hey, hey! Why don't we get matching shoes for the whole team? What do you think of these?!"

text_block_list.name: Teammate B
text_block_list.text:
Nice! It's red and super cool!
Isn't it great, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was hyped about getting matching shoes.
But the point of having matching things was something
I just couldn't understand at all.

text_block_list.name: Young Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
With just those few words, I became everyone's enemy.
After the same sort of thing happened a few times,
one day my Trainer called me in.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Cocon-chan, you're far too stubborn.
Try getting along with everyone a little more.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I quit the team. I was just
'an Umamusume who couldn't fit into the team.'

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's why I absolutely hated team competitions.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Team rankings change based on overall team strength,
so we totally have to "get along."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
While I was sulking...
Trainer Kashimoto suddenly called for me.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I manage my own team. There is no need
for any of you to influence one another.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, a professional team is meant to do their respective jobs
without unnecessary interference.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: If it is a team modeled after that, it may be suitable for you, but—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I know full well you didn't say that
because you actually care about me.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Still, for me... it was nice. It taught me that teams like that can exist too.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Even in team competitions,
I felt a small sense of responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
This team is...
a whole new world for me.

Little Cocon keeps her head down. After a brief silence,
Bitter Glace abruptly speaks up.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Same here.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huh... What about it?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I was the type people kept their distance from, thinking my passion for training was excessively abnormal.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
So this place is a whole new world to you.
Ahaha! Same here!
Bitter Glace's laughter echoed lightly beneath the starry sky.
—And so!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaah—!

Team First trained based on
Acting Director Kashimoto's program, and—
Afterward, she launched into a grueling session of three extra hours of training!

text_block_list.name: Member A
text_block_list.text: Even for me, this is a bit rough...

text_block_list.name: Member B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't space out!
You have to watch the race and learn from it!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Like hell I'm losing!

And past the final turn, into the homestretch!
Both accelerate at the exact same moment—
They crossed the finish line in a tangled rush.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Dammit, I almost broke past them...
So frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
Ah, it's been so long since a race got me this fired up!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"Still, 'exceptional lung capacity', huh?
I'd heard the rumors, but her stamina is truly something else."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's nothing! Running alongside someone with a competitive spirit really is effective! Let's add it to our routine from now on!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
............ "All team members will take a break from
training until the next Aoharu Cup."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
A mass boycott, on top of
brutal self-training...
Acting Principal Kashimoto gripped the letter with trembling hands.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I've... done it again...!
...I'm a failure as a Trainer...!
